info.name: Go-CRUD API - Complete Collection
info.description: Complete API collection with Health, Version, Auth, Users, Products, Vehicles, Waiting List (with Queue Progress & Mechanic Assignment), Maintenance, Settings, Invoices, Analytics, Roles & Pagination. Updated Feb 2026 with mechanic assignment feature - mechanics can view available queues, choose which customer to service first, and their name is displayed in queue progress.

request.description: Update own profile (all fields optional: name, phone, address, password).

query.description: Field to sort by (created_at, updated_at, name, email)
Filter by role: admin, mechanic, customer

request.description: Get all users with pagination, search, sort, and filter. Requires admin role.
Get user details by ID. Requires admin role.
Update user details (all fields optional: name, phone, address, password). Requires admin role.
Delete user by ID. Requires admin role.

query.description: Search in brand, model, license_plate, vin
Field to sort by (created_at, updated_at, brand, model)

request.description: Get all vehicles with pagination, search, and sort. Requires admin role.
Take queue with existing vehicle. EstimatedTime defaults to 0 and will be updated by mechanic after inspection.
Take queue and create a new vehicle at the same time. Useful for first-time customers.
Get all queue entries for the authenticated user
Get all queue entries for today
Get all queue entries for a specific date
Get queue entry by queue number and date
Check if tickets are still available for a specific date
Get real-time progress of service including position in queue, estimated wait time, and status

Cancel your own queue ticket. When you cancel, your ticket is returned to the system and other customers behind you in the queue are automatically moved up. You can only cancel your own tickets (verified by customer ID). Cannot cancel tickets that are already completed or already cancelled.

response.name: Success Response

request.description: Admin & Mechanic can view progress of ALL users' queues for a specific date. Shows customer names, phone numbers, vehicle details, mechanic name (if assigned), and complete progress information for each ticket.

Mechanic/Admin can view all available queues (waiting or called status) that are ready to be serviced. Shows customer details, vehicle info, and service type to help mechanic choose which customer to service first.

Mechanic assigns themselves to service a specific queue. This allows mechanics to choose which customer they want to service first. The mechanic's name will be shown in the queue details and progress.

item.name: Update Queue - Mechanic Adds Estimate & Notes

request.description: Mechanic/Admin updates the queue after inspection with time estimate (in minutes) and notes. This is the NEW endpoint for mechanic updates.
Call the customer - changes status to 'called' (Admin & Mechanic only)
Start the service - changes status to 'in_service'
Complete the service - changes status to 'completed' (Admin & Mechanic only)
Mark customer as no-show - changes status to 'no_show' (Admin & Mechanic only)
